title: DeReAct: Decomposed Reasoning and Acting for Reliable AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.02351v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: ReAct-based agents typically rely on a single LLM policy to propose actions, interact with the environment, and decide when a task is complete. This coupling makes action authorization and completion control difficult to enforce independently, allowing errors to propagate and unsupported completion claims to terminate execution. We introduce DeReAct, a modular agent architecture that externalizes two gating policies: a Critic that validates proposed actions before execution, and a Context Manager that reconstructs an environment-supported \textsc{State} and certifies task completion. translated_title: DeReAct：面向可靠AI智能体的分解式推理与行动
translated_abstract: 基于ReAct的智能体通常依赖单一的大语言模型策略来提出动作、与环境交互，并决定任务何时完成。这种耦合使得动作授权与任务完成控制难以独立执行，从而导致错误传播，以及缺乏依据的完成声明过早终止执行过程。我们提出了DeReAct，一种模块化的智能体架构，它将两种门控策略外置：一个Critic（评论者）在执行前验证所提出的动作，一个Context Manager（上下文管理器）重构环境支持的State（状态）并认证任务完成。在GAIA和SWE-bench Verified基准上，DeReAct对较弱的Brain模型在Pass@1上的提升最为显著，其中Qwen3-Coder-480B提升6.5–7.0分，Claude Sonnet 4.5提升4.2–5.2分；随着Brain模型能力的增强，提升幅度逐渐减小。轨迹与消融分析表明，当目标故障足够普遍时，外部门控才是有效的……
tldr: DeReAct提出了一种模块化智能体架构，通过将动作验证（Critic）与任务完成认证（Context Manager）从单一LLM策略中外置为独立门控机制，防止错误传播和无效完成声明，在GAIA和SWE-bench Verified上对较弱模型带来了最显著的Pass@1提升。
en_tdlr: DeReAct is a modular agent architecture that externalizes two gating policies—a Critic for validating proposed actions and a Context Manager for certifying task completion—preventing error propagation and unsupported completion claims, and yielding the largest Pass@1 gains for weaker Brain models on GAIA and SWE-bench Verified.
